blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines— A senior citizen was killed and three other passengers suffered injuries after a pickup-type multicab collided with a passenger bus past 11 a.m. on Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026, in Barangay Anislag, Pinamungajan. Police identified the fatality as alias “Maria,” 60, a resident of the town. The three injured passengers remained in a hospital on Monday. They were injured when the bus they were riding crashed into a roadside house. According to the Pinamungajan Police Station, the passenger bus was traveling toward Cebu City when it encountered the multicab.
